Assets are genuine in-game glyphs redistributed by community databases; not Capcom-hosted media.
Items/materials/decorations share inventory silhouettes and colours exactly as their source catalogue assigns. These are not unique 3D item renders.
Weapon icons are genuine type silhouettes; rarity tint is applied by the application, and full individual weapon renders are not used as type icons.
Special Track entries use their named target monster field-map icon, not a fabricated unique item picture.
